title: weave-record/1 reference
description: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 for the reference object used by refs, labels.consent, actor.grant and kind bodies (CONTRACT 6; DECISIONS B2/B4/B5). Hints are discovery aids only and never carry identity.

digest.title: reference digest
digest.description: Digest string of the referenced record. H0 checks sha256 strictly (exactly 64 lowercase hex characters); any other syntactically well-formed algorithm name is structurally valid but unsupported, so resolution becomes unverifiable instead of a record error (CONTRACT 3.6, DECISIONS B3, CONTRACT 22 Q13). Manifest positions, by contrast, require sha256 (CONTRACT 11.2 / 3.6).
